fieldContext.note: Combines EARS (Easy Approach to Requirements Syntax: 5 natural language templates) with Specification by Example (SbE), decision tables, and boundary counterexamples.
fieldContext.source: Mavin et al. (EARS) / Adzic (Specification by Example)

personalNotes: EARS 5 syntax patterns: Ubiquitous ('The system shall...'), Event-driven ('WHEN... the system shall...'), State-driven ('WHILE... the system shall...'), Option-driven ('WHERE... the system shall...'), Complex ('WHILE... WHEN... the system shall...').
